dialogues.speaker: Camden
dialogues.text: Oh, that... That's, uh, an old issue from way back when.

dialogues.speaker: Camden
dialogues.text: Just don't go touching it again, please. I don't want my whole world to start spinning while I'm enjoying a proper snooze...

dialogues.speaker: Camden
dialogues.text: And if something does go wrong I can't act like I didn't see anything this time. I mean, I'm right here.

dialogues.speaker: Camden
dialogues.text: And if say I didn't see anything, that would prove I've been sleeping on the job. I hope you can understand.
